title: Return a greeting
summary: Solidity: Return a greeting. Change the greeting and redeploy in Remix VM.
introduction: A contract groups functions and data. Call message() to read a greeting without changing stored data.
learningObjectives: Change the greeting and redeploy in Remix VM

blocks.text: Paste one contract into Remix and choose compiler 0.8.24 or later in the 0.8 series. Deploy only to Remix VM for practice. Call the function named in the lesson; shown results are return values.

blocks.title: Return a greeting

blocks.text: message is pure, so it reads no stored state. Calling it returns the string literal.
Change the greeting and redeploy in Remix VM.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use the practice VM; no wallet or real money is needed.
